messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC #1765432100 created — High GPU OOM rate on decode-worker-us-west-2 while streaming responses. Error spike started ~1765432000. Sample error: `CUDA out of memory` in decode loop. Paging oncall.
maria: paging oncall-sre now — seeing OOMs across 3 pods, memory jumps right before crash. Not consistent with normal tail length distribution. Possible runaway generation.
kevin: I’m looking at the runtime metrics. Per-request token_count has spikes to 100k for some sessions. Suspect max_tokens override got pushed by client or misconfig default.
beth: support reports ~120 customer requests dropped (500s) in last 8m. Affected customers are high-throughput chat apps. Raising P1 customer impact.
samir: I can throttle ingress and apply emergency global token cap at the gateway. Quick mitigation: reject requests with tokens > 5k. Would that break anything critical? 
maria: do it. Add soft 5k cap, return 4xx with helpful msg. We need immediate protection, then we can investigate causation.
kevin: rolling a config patch to runtime-configs namespace. Patch preview:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  default_max_tokens: "5000"
```
Applying now to staging and then prod.
samir: applied token cap at edge (nginx-lua) with rate limit key=user_id and max_tokens check. ops-bot: deploy-started token-cap-edge 1765432223
ops-bot: deploy-success token-cap-edge 1765432240
maria: confirm traffic — requests >5k now rejected at gateway. OOM rate fell immediately on decode-worker group.
beth: Customer-facing incident message drafted, sending to affected accounts. Notifying enterprise customers in the next 10m.
kevin: still seeing a couple of pods with high KV cache growth leading to CUDA OOMs. Suspect bad prompt prefix that repeats. Pulling recent traces for the top offending req ids.
jordan: taking over handoff in 15m. maria — can you summarize actions and what to look for in the handoff? 
maria: summary: 1) Gateway token cap applied (5000). 2) Killed 3 runaway decode pods that were crashed and restarted. 3) Rolled default_max_tokens config to 5000. 4) Adding temporary fallback routing to smaller model variant for high token requests. Watchlist: KV cache growth, decode loop CPU usage, memory growth trends.
kevin: routing patch: add rule to route requests with tokens >2k to small-decoder-quantized model. Will push after handoff to avoid churn.
samir: infra note — scaled up decode-pool by +2 nodes to give headroom while we flush KV caches. Also enabled node-level eviction for pods consuming >90% GPU mem.
ops-bot: scale-event decode-pool +2 nodes 1765432410
maria: logs snippet from one offending request:
```
[decode] req=xyz123 token_count=98765
Attaching to CUDA stream
CUDA error: out of memory at decode.cc:345
```
kevin: that token_count looks like max_tokens misconfig on client side. We should validate incoming max_tokens header in the API surface in code.
beth: support update: ~40 customers still impacted with intermittent 500s; overall success rate recovering after token cap. Sending targeted note to top 10 customers.
jordan: oncall takeover: I will own followups. Next steps for postmortem: - identify how max_tokens could be set so high (client bug? proxy header manipulation?) - add server-side hard cap and validation - add alert for token_count distribution anomaly - add runbook step to route high-token requests to fallback smaller model.
maria: agreed. Also request an infra ticket to add per-request KV cache accounting so we can evict per-session keys if a session grows runaway.
samir: creating infra ticket INF-176543 - per-session KV accounting + eviction policy.
ops-bot: ticket-created INF-176543 1765432560
kevin: code action: PR opened to add header validation and hard cap in api-gateway: https://git/repo/pull/2345 — will include tests for max_tokens > 10000.
beth: posted incident banner to status page and linked to customer notes.
jordan: closing active mitigation — OOMs back to baseline, pod restarts stabilized. Keeping incident open for post-incident actions and root cause analysis.
incident-bot: Incident #1765432100 status update: mitigated — monitoring. Keep open for RCA.
maria: post-incident checklist: 1) RCA writeup 2) Add integration test for max_tokens boundary 3) Update runbooks 4) Customer follow-up summary. Assigning owners: RCA=kevin, infra=samir, runbook=maria, customer=beth.
kevin: timeline note: root cause likely a combination of client misconfig sending extreme max_tokens + lack of server-side validation + no early traffic routing for long-tail token distributions. Plan to harden API and add histogram alert for token length.
beth: will prepare customer-facing summary after RCA draft. Thanks team — nice quick mitigation work. :thumbsup:
jordan: handing to 2nd-shift oncall — I'll monitor overnight for regressions and ensure the token cap stays in place. Closing thread after RCA posted.
